title: A Treatise on the Meridian-Fed Garrote
summary: Teaches a full-meridian student to feed the cord with qi and bring down a strong target by the neck.

title: The Living Field and the Cord
summary: Shows a Xiantian cultivator how to extend the qi field along the cord so it reaches and grips beyond the arms.

title: Cord Work Against Many Foes
summary: Treats the garrote in a crowd, using one held foe as a shield and a cord trap to slow pursuit.

title: Canon of the Extended Cord
summary: Sets out long-reach casting, ringing line and sustained strangling pull for a Xiantian cultivator working at the cord's full length.

title: The Dual-Track Garrote Reader
summary: A reader of paired-cord work in which body track and qi track share each pull, taught in the Azure Sky manner.

title: Hawk and River Treatise on the Cord
summary: Joins the hawk's stoop and the river's bend in twin-cord casting, shown to Xiantian students of the Azure Sky schools.

title: The Azure Field Garrote Canon
summary: The formal court canon of paired-cord work inside the azure field, for senior Xiantian students with a Sovereignty ceiling.

title: Oath of the Plateau Cord
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn garrote stance and the oath-bound knot to full-meridian students of the Gale plateau schools.

title: Wind-Sworn Treatise on the Open Cord
summary: Spreads field qi along an open cord in gusts, a Gale text for Xiantian students holding a Sovereignty ceiling.

title: The Bearing Cord of the High Plateau
summary: Teaches keeping a fixed bearing on the target's throat with crosswind casts, wind-held loops and a plateau trap.
